jobs.occupation: CE Dump Truck Driver – Reliable Shuttle Between Sint-Katelijne-Waver & Hemiksem
jobs.description:
As a CE Dump Truck Driver (m/f/x), you are responsible for daily shuttle transport between Sint-Katelijne-Waver and Hemiksem. You operate a tipper truck to ensure goods are loaded, transported, and unloaded safely and correctly. Safety, punctuality, and a strong sense of responsibility are key in this role.

Your average workday begins with a vehicle inspection. You load materials, depart on time to the next location, and ensure smooth delivery. In addition to transporting goods, you handle transport documents correctly and comply with driving and rest time regulations. You keep your truck clean and well-maintained. After your shift, you may take the truck home.

Can you see yourself driving between these two fixed sites for a reliable client? Apply today and secure a stable, well-paid job with future prospects!

• You have a valid CE driving license

• You are up to date with Code 95 and medical examination

• Experience with tipper transport is a plus, not a must

• You are punctual, reliable, and able to work independently

• You have a strong sense of responsibility

• You speak and understand basic Dutch or English

• You have at least lower secondary education

• 0 to 5 years of experience is sufficient

• Both junior and medior profiles are welcome

jobs.occupation: Facade Painter – Working at Heights F/X/M
jobs.description:
Step up to a career that reaches new heights! As a Facade Painter, you'll play a crucial role in transforming and maintaining industrial and commercial buildings. Your expertise will shine as you handle various exterior painting projects, ensuring that every stroke of your brush adds value and beauty.   In your day-to-day role, you'll prepare and clean facades, apply primers and topcoats, and work with precision from scaffolding or aerial platforms. Your keen eye for detail and commitment to safety will ensure that every project is completed to the highest standard.   Ready to elevate your career? Apply now to join a team that values precision, safety, and craftsmanship, and where your skills will be put to great use every single day.

• Experience as an exterior or industrial painter is a strong plus

• Communicative English

• No fear of heights – experience with aerial platforms or rope techniques is an asset

• Ability to work neatly with an eye for detail

• Adherence to safety rules and enjoy working outdoors

• VCA certificate is a plus (or willingness to obtain one)

• Driving license B is an asset

Are you ready to take your skills to the next level as a Die Cutting Machine Operator? We're looking for someone like you to join our dynamic team. You'll set up and operate cutting-edge machinery in a fast-paced environment, ensuring precision and quality in every product.

In this role, you'll start your day by setting up the die cutter based on order specifications. Your keen eye for detail will ensure everything is in its right place, from adjusting feeder plates to installing dies. You'll work across two shifts, maintaining high standards of quality and efficiency to meet production goals.

Ready to make your mark in an industry-leading company? Apply today and become part of a team that values precision, quality, and innovation.

• Minimum of 2 years experience as a Die Cutting Machine Operator

• Technical knowledge, gained through studies or practical experience

• Communicative knowledge of English

• Affinity with technology and attention to detail

• Willingness to work two shifts: 1st shift from Monday to Thursday, 5:15 to 13:15, and Friday, 5:00 to 13:00; 2nd shift from Monday to Thursday, 13:15 to 21:15, and Friday, 11:00 to 17:00

Are you ready to take your career in offset printing to the next level? We are seeking a skilled Offset Printer to ensure our high-quality standards are met in every print run. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a team that values precision, efficiency, and teamwork.

In this role, your day will start by setting up and operating our state-of-the-art offset printing machines. You will be responsible for maintaining the printers, ensuring consistent quality, and troubleshooting any issues that arise during the production process. Collaboration is key as you'll work alongside other professionals to meet production goals and deadlines.

If you're passionate about printing and looking for a role where your contributions are valued, apply now! Join us and become an integral part of a workplace that offers growth and learning opportunities.

• At least 2-3 years of experience as an offset printer
• Technical qualifications in printing at A2/A3 level or equivalent experience
• Experience in multi-color offset printing; experience in printing on solid board or CBA is an additional advantage
• Team player with strong communication skills and the ability to maintain a collaborative work environment
• Attention to detail with an excellent sense of quality and safety
• Communicative knowledge of English or Dutch

jobs.occupation: Customer Service | Czech + English + Eastern-European Language
jobs.description:
Are you a born problem solver with a passion for customer satisfaction? Do you want to work in an international environment where no day is the same? Then we have the perfect challenge for you! At Volvo, they are looking for an enthusiastic customer service representative to join their Central-East team and contribute to their mission of getting vehicles back on the road quickly and efficiently. Your duties: 

 
• Provide first line support for international breakdowns: Wherever our customers are in Europe, you will be there to help them and address their concerns. 
 

 
• Maintain regular contact with dealers and customers: So that everyone is always informed about the progress of repairs. 
 

 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support. 
 Keywords: customer support advisor, customer service, call agent, customer service representative
Bachelor thinking level. Fluent in English + Czech + one of following: Polish, Lithuanian, German (minimum B2 level). 

Flexible in working hours: Working in a full-time system is not a problem for you; rather, you enjoy the variety. Driving license B: You must be able to come to the company independently.

jobs.occupation: Talencia Consulting - ERP Project Manager Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Talencia is looking for a "Job title" for one of its clients.

Location : Bruxelles and La Louviére

Start date : October

Duration : 2 years

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead and coordinate a major ERP transformation project focused on Supply Chain processes.

The Project Manager will be responsible for coordinating the different functional and technical teams involved in the project, with a particular focus on the analysis and design phase.

You will act as the central point of coordination between business stakeholders, functional analysts, technical teams, key users and external implementation partners. Your role is to ensure that the different teams work towards a common objective, that dependencies are properly managed and that the analysis activities progress according to scope, planning and quality expectations.

The ideal candidate has strong experience managing complex ERP projects and is comfortable operating in environments involving multiple stakeholders, parallel workstreams and significant business transformation.

Description

Project management & coordination:

 
• Take ownership of the overall planning and coordination of the ERP project.
 
• Coordinate multiple functional and technical workstreams.
 
• Define and monitor project milestones, deliverables, dependencies and priorities.
 
• Ensure that the different teams remain aligned with the overall project objectives.
 
• Organise and facilitate project meetings, workshops and follow-up sessions.
 
• Monitor progress and proactively identify delays, dependencies, risks and blockers.
 
• Ensure effective communication between business, IT and implementation partners.
 
• Provide regular project status reporting to management and key stakeholders.

Coordination of the analysis phase:

A major part of the role will be to coordinate and structure the functional analysis activities rather than performing all analysis personally.

 
• Coordinate the functional analysts working on the different Supply Chain processes.
 
• Structure the analysis approach, priorities and deliverables.
 
• Ensure that functional teams have a clear understanding of scope and expected outcomes.
 
• Coordinate workshops with business stakeholders and key users.
 
• Ensure consistency between analyses performed across different processes and teams.
 
• Identify gaps, overlaps and dependencies between functional workstreams.
 
• Challenge proposed solutions where necessary and ensure alignment with the overall ERP strategy.
 
• Track open points, decisions, assumptions and actions resulting from the analysis.
 
• Ensure that functional specifications and process documentation are delivered on time and with the expected quality.

Supply chain ERP transformation:

The project focuses on the transformation and optimisation of Supply Chain processes within an ERP environment, including areas such as

 
• Procurement and purchasing
 
• Supplier processes
 
• Product and article master data
 
• Inventory and stock management
 
• Warehouse management
 
• Order management
 
• Logistics and delivery processes
 
• End-to-end Supply Chain process flows
 
• Integration with other ERP and business processes

The project manager

does not need to be the deepest functional expert in every area, but must have sufficient ERP and Supply Chain understanding to coordinate experts, challenge decisions and understand project impacts and dependencies.

Stakeholder management:

 
• Act as the primary...
...

Must have:

• 7+ years of experience in IT Project Management, ideally within ERP transformation projects

• Proven experience coordinating multiple teams and workstreams

• Experience managing projects involving business analysis and functional design

• Strong understanding of ERP environments and Supply Chain processes

• Experience coordinating functional analysts and business stakeholders

• Strong project planning, dependency and risk management skills

• Experience working with external implementation partners

• Strong stakeholder management and communication capabilities

• Ability to challenge functional solutions without necessarily being the hands-on expert

• Experience working in complex transformation environments

• Fluent in French and English

 

Nice to have:

• Experience with large-scale ERP implementations or rollouts

• Previous experience in Supply Chain transformation projects

• Experience with data migration or master data projects

• Experience in Agile, hybrid or Waterfall project environments

• Experience coordinating international teams

 

In case of interest in this job, please send us immediately your updated resume.

Kind Regards,
